artist.name: KAMPAI
artist.bio: KAMPAI is the solo project of Rumit Virmani, a DJ and curator from Mumbai based in Bengaluru. He plays sets across Afro house, global bass, baile funk, UK garage and drum and bass, and ran the Kampailation show on boxout.fm. He has played VH1 Supersonic and NH7 Weekender and co-founded SoMAD Fest.
